title: Tangle Knot 3D
description: Untangle realistic physics-driven braided ropes knotted across brass board pins by moving anchors one slot at a time until every cord hangs free.
controls: Drag rope pins into open board sockets to uncross every tangled cord before running out of moves.

zh-CN.title: 3D 绳子解谜
zh-CN.description: 拟真物理 3D 拆绳挑战：把交错缠绕在木板铜柱上的彩色编织绳逐一挪位解开，丝滑拉直全盘清空。
zh-CN.controls: 按住绳子端点的圆栓拖拽至空洞插槽，消除所有绳索交叉打结即可过关。
